overall_goal: Wrap the cake log in foil and store it in the fridge.

goals.description: Prepare a sheet of aluminum foil.
goals.rationale: The person opens the foil box, takes out the roll, unrolls a piece, tears it off, and places it on the chopping board.

goals.description: Wrap the mixture in the foil.
goals.rationale: The person places the mixture onto the foil, rolls it up to cover the mixture, and folds the ends to seal it.

goals.description: Make space and place the wrapped mixture in the fridge.
goals.rationale: The person carries the wrapped mixture to the fridge, rearranges items to make room, and places the log inside.
